record.question: Among the following food plants mentioned which one is used for rearing domesticated silkworm?
record.explanation: Soalu (Machilus bombycina/symplocos) is the known food plant for Muga silkworm (Antheraea assamensis) rearing in Northeast India sericulture. Castor is used for Eri silkworm, oak for Tasar silkworm, and tapioca is not a standard sericulture food plant for domesticated silkworms.
